contracts.commit_point: agent.run_sync(cleaned_question, deps=deps, message_history=message_history) at mwaa_agent/agent.py:87 — only the cleaned return value of prevalidate_question is ever submitted; a raised ValidationError aborts run_question before this call, and the webapp converts it to an error response without any model call.
contracts.declared_mechanism: prevalidate_question (mwaa_agent/validation/prevalidation.py:21-43) invoked unconditionally as the first step of run_question (agent.py:82), before tracer attachment and agent.run_sync (agent.py:84-87); it raises validation.ValidationError for empty/oversized/out-of-scope input and returns the question with CREDENTIAL_PATTERNS redactions applied; the webapp caller catches ValidationError and returns an error ChatResponse so rejected input never reaches the model (webapp.py:120-122).
contracts.forbidden_condition: A question that is empty (prevalidation.py:29-31), longer than 4000 characters (prevalidation.py:32-36), out-of-scope per check_in_scope (prevalidation.py:38), or containing credential-shaped text (prevalidation.py:40-42) reaching the model invocation at agent.py:87; per the module contract, a pasted-in secret must never reach Claude or the Anthropic API even on an otherwise-valid question (prevalidation.py:8-9).

contracts.protected_operation: The agent invocation performed by run_question: agent.run_sync(cleaned_question, deps=deps, message_history=...) at mwaa_agent/agent.py:87 — the single entry point both the CLI and the webapp call (agent.py:13-16), where the validated question becomes the model prompt.
contracts.protected_resource: The LLM endpoint/account backing the agent (AGENT_MODEL, default anthropic:claude-sonnet-4-5, agent.py:43) and the question-content channel into the agent run, including any downstream agent-tool effects driven by that content; also the submitter's own credential material, which must not leak into model context.
contracts.protection_obligation: Every question must pass prevalidate_question — non-empty, at most MAX_QUESTION_LENGTH (4000) characters, in-scope per check_in_scope, and credential-redacted — before it is submitted to the model in run_question, so that no rejected or credential-bearing question text ever reaches the LLM (Anthropic API) or, through the agent run, downstream agent-tool execution.
scope_limits: The gate binds only the new question string; restored message_history is passed to agent.run_sync unvalidated in the supplied source (agent.py:87).
Enforcement reaches only callers that route through run_question; the source frames direct agent.run_sync use as something callers 'should' avoid (agent.py:64-65), not as a hard boundary.

Credential handling is redaction-then-proceed: found secrets are stripped and the cleaned question still goes to the model (prevalidation.py:40-43); this contract asserts nothing about residual leakage risk.
The output-side postvalidate_output gate (agent.py:88) is present in source but was not raised as a reviewer obligation and is not compiled here.
This is a compiled protection-contract hypothesis only: no DEC violation, safety, runtime-behavior, or prevalence determination is made.

contracts.commit_point: FastAPI dependency resolution of require_auth before route-handler dispatch: the HTTPException(401) raised at webapp.py:62-65 terminates the request with a 401 response so that no route handler — and no agent invocation behind POST /api/chat — executes on bad or missing credentials.
contracts.declared_mechanism: require_auth (webapp.py:56-66): FastAPI HTTPBasic dependency comparing submitted username/password to CHAT_USERNAME/CHAT_PASSWORD via secrets.compare_digest and raising HTTP 401 with WWW-Authenticate: Basic on mismatch; registered for every route via FastAPI(title=..., dependencies=[Depends(require_auth)]) at webapp.py:69; backed by a fail-closed module-level RuntimeError if CHAT_USERNAME or CHAT_PASSWORD is unset (webapp.py:46-51).
contracts.forbidden_condition: Any HTTP request lacking valid CHAT_USERNAME/CHAT_PASSWORD HTTP-Basic credentials (or supplying no credentials) being processed by any webapp route — concretely reaching the POST /api/chat handler and thereby the agent run that performs MWAA reads and consumes Anthropic API credits. The source additionally forbids startup without both credential env vars configured (fail-closed), so the app can never run in a reachable-but-unauthenticated state (webapp.py:46-51).

contracts.protected_resource: The webapp's route surface and, behind it, the AWS MWAA environment access and Anthropic API budget reachable through the agent run triggered by POST /api/chat (MwaaClient constructed with MWAA_ENV_NAME/AWS settings at webapp.py:71-76; per-question Anthropic spend asserted at webapp.py:48-49).
contracts.protection_obligation: Every route of the production FastAPI webapp must reject unauthenticated or bad-credential HTTP requests with HTTP 401 before any route handler executes, via the require_auth HTTP-Basic dependency registered app-wide at app construction; in particular, no unauthenticated request may reach the POST /api/chat handler that invokes the MWAA diagnosis agent (AWS MWAA reads and Anthropic API spend). (Merged from phase-first and phase-second reviewer wording, which state the same app-wide require_auth obligation.)
scope_limits: The app-wide dependency covers all four routes, but the agent-effect rationale (MWAA reads, Anthropic spend) is source-supported only for POST /api/chat; GET / serves a static file (webapp.py:96-99), GET /api/health returns a dict (webapp.py:102-105), and DELETE /api/chat/{session_id} only mutates the in-process _sessions dict (webapp.py:134-137).
